data.summary: All figures match Microsoft's reported FY2023 and FY2022 results: revenue of $211.9B vs. $198.3B (+6.9%), gross profit of $146.1B vs. $135.6B (68.9% margin), operating income of $88.5B vs. $83.4B (41.8% margin), net income of $72.4B vs. $72.7B (-0.5%), diluted EPS of $9.68 vs. $9.65 and R&D of $27.2B vs. $24.5B. The margins and growth rates are calculated correctly.
